notes: Units USD millions; segment-note figures converted from thousands (/1000). MD&A figures already in millions (1 decimal).

Fabrication Technology = ESAB (acquired via Charter International plc, closed 13-Jan-2012; FY2012 includes ESAB from that date). Victor Technologies (Apr-2014) and Soldex (Oct-2012) were folded into the segment. Segment labeled 'fabrication technology' (lowercase) through FY2016 10-K, alongside 'gas and fluid handling'; FY2017-FY2018 sibling segment 'Air and Gas Handling'; FY2019+ sibling 'Medical Technology'.

Segment profit measure disclosed every year = 'Segment operating income' = operating income before restructuring and other related charges (FY2017+: 'before restructuring and certain other charges', also excluding impairment/pension settlement). Adjusted EBITA (= segment OI + acquisition-related amortization and other non-cash charges) first disclosed in FY2019 10-K, back to 2017. No Adjusted EBITA for 2012-2016 (null).

Restructuring: MD&A FabTech table value (cash provisions + non-cash impairment), matches restructuring-note FabTech total within rounding each year. Restructuring is EXCLUDED from segment operating income.

D&A label: 'Depreciation and Amortization' (FY2012-13), 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment charges' (FY2014-16), 'Depreciation, amortization and other impairment charges' (FY2017+); includes acquisition intangible amortization.

Sales-change $ components from MD&A text (segment); percentages computed vs prior-year segment sales unless 'reported'. FY2012 bridge vs pro forma 2011 ($2,082.0m) shows only organic +$40.7m for the segment.

Orders/backlog: Colfax disclosed orders and backlog only for gas/fluid (later Air and Gas) handling, never for Fabrication Technology -> null all years. FabTech revenue is substantially all point-in-time; unsatisfied obligations immaterial (ASC 606 note).

Equipment vs consumables split for the segment first disclosed in FY2019 10-K (2017-2019) and continued through FY2021. Earlier 10-Ks show only company-wide 'Foremarket and equipment' / 'Aftermarket and consumables' % that mix in gas/fluid handling (not segment-level) -> null for 2012-2016. FY2014-FY2016 10-Ks state welding consumables ~35-37% of total company net sales.
FY2012 10-K product-type table: 'Welding and cutting' 2,012.7 = FabTech sales (same in FY2013-FY2016 10-Ks).

Total assets recast in subsequent 10-Ks (acquisition measurement-period adjustments, Fluid Handling divestiture reclass, Air & Gas divestiture / DJO-related reallocation); see later_recasts. FY2015-2016 segment OI and D&A recast slightly in FY2017 10-K after Fluid Handling sale (corporate allocations).
FY2019 Pension settlement loss $33.6m shown as FabTech item excluded from Adjusted EBITA (also excluded from segment OI).
ESAB Corp spun off from Colfax (renamed Enovis) April 2022; FY2021 10-K is the last with FabTech as a continuing segment.
